source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of blockchain fundamentals (PDF 161-162).

blocks.text: Blockchain doston ke group ki mushtarak digital copy jaisa hai jo hisab rakhte hain ke kis ne kis ka qarz dena hai. Ek shakhs ki bajaye sab ke paas copy hoti hai, aur har tabdeeli, jaise qarz wapas karna, ek saath tamam copies mein likhi jati hai.

items: Shaffafiyat: sab copy dekh sakte hain, to dhoka ya chhupi tabdeeli pakri jati hai.
Hifazat: likhne ke baad andraj mitana taqreeban na-mumkin, kyunke cryptography unhein band kar deti hai.
Decentralization: koi ek shakhs ya computer zimmedar nahi; sab ke paas barabar copy, aur tabdeeli ke liye aksariyat ki raza zaroori.

blocks.alt: Oopar: teen blocks ek qataar mein, har ek mein pichhle block ka hash, timestamp, transactions aur apna hash, teeron se jure. Neeche baen: chhe nodes N1 se N6 peer-to-peer network mein sab ek doosre se jure. Neeche daen: decentralization, immutability, consensus, transparency, security aur ajza node, ledger, block, transaction aur protocol ke notes.
blocks.caption: Jure blocks, peer-to-peer network aur blockchain ke usool (topic 6.4 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).
blocks.long_description: Har block pichhle block ka hash, timestamp aur apni transactions rakhta hai, aur us ka apna hash hota hai. Agar koi purana block badle to us ka hash badal jayega aur agle block mein rakhi copy se mel nahi khayega, to chhed-chhaar zahir ho jayegi. Peer-to-peer network ka har node ledger ki poori copy rakhta aur baghair markazi server ke doosron se seedha baat karta hai. Network decentralization, immutability, Proof of Work ya Proof of Stake jaise consensus qawaid, shaffafiyat aur cryptographic hifazat par chalta hai.

blocks.prompt: Mushtarak copy mein ek dost ke liye dhoka dena mushkil kyun hai?
blocks.explanation: Baqi sab ke paas wahi record hai aur farq nazar aa jayega, aur tabdeeli ke liye aksariyat ki raza chahiye.

items: Mushtarak copy ki tarah blockchain: shaffaf, mehfooz, decentralized.
